description: This file defines the interface for the MotionDetection plugin class, including method declarations, class structure, and relevant includes. It sets up the class for a plugin that handles motion detection functionalities via JSON-RPC in a WPEFramework-based application.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: A class implementing a motion detection plugin that handles JSON-RPC communication, provides interfaces for initializing, deinitializing, and handling motion detection events, and supports external JSONRPC communication.

methods.name: getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves information about available motion detectors.

methods.name: isarmed
methods.description: Checks if the system is armed.

methods.name: setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period of time to consider no motion detected.

methods.name: getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current no-motion period setting.

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity level for motion detection.

methods.name: getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Gets the elapsed time since the last motion event.

methods.name: setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets the period during which motion events are active.

methods.name: getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Gets the current active period for motion events.

methods.name: onMotionEvent
methods.description: Event handler called when a motion event occurs.
